text:
Lina: quick flag — got 3 customer complaints, invoices showing mixed rates for Nov cohort 2 (some tokens charged at new-experiment rate, some at legacy). examples: `INV-9234`, `INV-9239`
Raj: ugh — is this the A/B rate experiment rollout? which cohort are they in?
Priya: yes, these are in the AB_rate_test (cohort B = new rate). they were supposed to be grandfathered until 2026-12-01 per policy.
Lina: correct, governance doc says grandfather until end of year. looks like billing applied new rate for some billable windows.
Marco: checking logs now. saw a race where the flag evaluation happens after usage summarization. quick snippet:
```
// billing-summary
if (rate_flag.available) {
  rate = feature_flag.rate
} else {
  rate = customer.legacy_rate
}
// race: summarize_usage() can run before flag is cached
```
Priya: oh no — that explains partial charging. those invoices that mixed lines had usage near midnight when rollout changed config.
billing-bot: ALERT: 3 invoices flagged by rules engine (reason: mixed_rate_lines). ids: INV-9234,INV-9239,INV-9241. link: https://billing.redwood/internal/alerts/1762345679 :warning:
Connor: priority: pause cohort B rollout, create credits for affected invoices, announce to customers? approval needed from @Raj? :eyes:
Raj: yes approve pause. Marco — can you gate the feature flag immediately and set backfill window to re-run billing for affected customers?
Marco: pausing flag now. pushing hotfix to ensure flag is resolved before summarize. will run a backfill job for the three invoices. ETA 45m for job to complete.
Priya: I'll draft a short customer note (apology + credit) and coordinate with CS for the three accounts.
Lina: can we auto-issue credits to avoid manual ops? Connor, can finance sign off on credit policy?
Connor: finance ok to auto-issue credits up to $5k per invoice for this class; for anything above we'll escalate. please include memo code `CREDIT-AB-MIX-2026`.
Marco: backfill job started. sample job log: `backfill: INV-9234 lines corrected: 4, total_credit: $112.34`
billing-bot: JOB_COMPLETE: backfill/1762345705 (duration 00:36). impacted invoices updated and credits queued.
Lina: thanks — I pushed a quick runbook in #help/billing: steps we followed + rollout hold ID (hold-1762345679).
Priya: created customer outreach draft for CS + legal review. will send to the three accounts now.
Raj: postmortem please. need root cause, fix plan (Marco), testing checklist, and a sign-off before we re-enable cohort B.
Marco: will own postmortem. immediate fix is to make flag resolution synchronous in summarize path and add e2e test that simulates midnight switch. longer term: move to atomic rate assignment at ingestion.
Connor: I'll log the credits and update revenue reports. finance will run a reconciliation run next week to ensure ARR impact is tracked.
Lina: great — thanks team. tagging follow-ups: @Marco (postmortem), @Priya (customer comms), @Connor (reconciliation). :thumbsup:
